insight: Buy utility items with duration-based buffs like Solar Crest, Drums, Pipe, Crimson Guard, and Greaves. Largo's innate extends buff duration by 10-20%, making these items exceptionally valuable.

Max Catchy Lick first for dispel utility. Use it to remove enemy buffs like Ursa's Overpower and debuffs from allies, while securing ranged creeps. Provides 40-100 health restoration to Largo when dispelling.

Level Catchy Lick at level 1 about 80% of the time. Pair it with Frog Stomp at level 2 for synergy: place Frog Stomp behind retreating enemies, then Catchy Lick them back into the stomp range to win trades.

Frog Stomp clears creep waves from 800 range. With level 10 talent increasing damage from 455 to 560, it one-shots creep waves even with Croak of Genius buffs. Play off-lane to farm waves, then return to buff teammates.

Take 2 points in Catchy Lick and Frog Stomp by level 4. Delay Croak of Genius until level 8 since percent damage reverb is only valuable once teammates have significant spell damage. Max Frog Stomp after level 4.

Buy Aghanim's Shard when running single-target buff items like Glimmer Cape, Solar Crest, Lotus Orb, or Linken's Sphere. Shard applies buffs to both target and Largo, doubling item value with extended duration from innate.

At level 10, take +105 Frog Stomp damage talent 95% of the time to maintain one-shot wave clear. At level 20, take +10 Grooven armor aura talent (99% of the time) for team-wide armor equivalent to Assault Cuirass.
At level 15, take +1.5% max HP per second damage talent with Croak of Genius if team has DoT heroes like Guap or Zeus. Refreshing DoT damage repeatedly stacks the max health percentage effect.

Prioritize mana boots and mana-providing items since ultimate requires continuous mana to apply buffs. As long as Largo has mana, he can apply limitless buffs to teammates with the guitar hero ultimate.

Toggle ultimate to access three buffs: offensive (magic damage + spell amp), utility (move speed + slow resistance), and healing. Rapidly press the buff hotkey each second to continuously reapply. Small timing window prevents accidental cancellation.
Build either AoE auras (Drums, Greaves, Crimson, Holy Locket) or single-target buffs (Glimmer, Solar Crest with Shard). Choose based on what's more impactful each game rather than fixed itemization.
Use Blink Dagger and Ether Lens for positioning to apply ultimate buffs safely without getting caught. Items like Octarine Core reduce ultimate cooldowns, allowing more frequent buff applications.
Catchy Lick's basic dispel is extremely effective in laning against heroes relying on buff-based defense. Dispel Orchid and similar items later in the game to save teammates.
